## Changes made

The article was captured as 12 screenshots (`images/page-01.jpg` to `page-12.jpg`) in a browser at 1024 × 768 CSS pixels, scrolling down 640 pixels per page so that consecutive pages overlap. The capture covers the article from the top of the page to the start of the 软件 (Software) section. The software lists, references and navigation boxes after it were not captured. The text was not edited.
